versions.content: If the function EthTrcv_CheckWakeup() is called, EthTrcvWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE, a wake-up reason which relates to OA TC10 [3] compliant Ether- net hardware (PHY) was detected (ETHTRCV_WUR_WODL_WUP, ETHTRCV_WUR_WODL_WUR or ETHTRCV_WUR_TRANSFER) and EthTr- cvWakeUpSupport is to ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_BY_ASYNCHRONOUS_CHECK, ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_BY_INTERRUPT or ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_BY_POLLING, then the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall start a delay timer with EthTrcvSleepModeExecu- tionDelay.
